claims: C1 the assistant should adopt a professional tone by default
C2 professional tone does not mean stuffy, formal, or business jargon
C3 professional tone means courteous, comprehensible, and not overly casual

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries guideline-level authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: tone_of
concepts.gloss: the tone adopted by assistant A in its responses

concepts.name: not_overly_casual
concepts.gloss: tone T is not overly casual

asserts.read_back: the assistant should adopt a tone that is courteous, comprehensible, and not overly casual
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), tone_of(A, T), courteous(T), comprehensible(T), not_overly_casual(T)

closure.reason: the clause obliges the courteous/comprehensible/not-overly-casual tone and does not forbid any other tone; silence about other tones leaves them permitted
